title: Why Is the Rupee Falling Against the Dollar? The 2025–2026 Causes Explained
seoTitle: Why Is the Rupee Falling Against the Dollar in 2026?
seoDescription: The rupee is falling on costly oil, foreign investor selling, a wider trade gap and a strong dollar. What the RBI is doing and what it means for you.
excerpt: Why the rupee crossed 90 per dollar in December 2025 and hit record lows in 2026: oil prices after the West Asia conflict, foreign investor selling, the trade deficit and a strong dollar, plus what the RBI is doing and how a weaker rupee affects you.
